title: Peer evidence boundaries and fast FreeCAD native qualification
mode: Primary-source documentation, source, and issue/PR review
scope: Reconcile open-source DWG/DXF library claims by operation and version.
Check whether FreeCAD native qualification has a faster supported headless C++ importer route.
Refine implementation readiness without adding fixtures, dependencies, or per-slice external tests.

method.kind: Public project manuals, source pages, issue and pull-request records
method.limitations: The findings describe public source/documentation and reported issue evidence only. No packaged FreeCAD build was checked for the merged fix, no local native import was performed, and no peer output was compared.

sources.name: LibreDWG manual, decoding and encoding sections
sources.observed: The manual distinguishes broad DWG reading from writing and states R2007 writing is unavailable while R2010-R2018 writing still fails CRC/audit checks. Project-level and release-level writer descriptions vary, requiring exact artifact and operation pins.

sources.name: ACadSharp README/version matrix
sources.observed: The advertised matrix separates DXF/DWG reader and writer support by AC version; it lists AC1021 DWG read but not DWG write. Matrix entries remain project claims until exact runtime and semantic behavior are observed.

sources.name: ACadSharp open spline report
sources.observed: The report names ACadSharp 3.8.0 and a DWG-to-DXF spline failure chain through GDAL. It is a peer failure report, not a local reproduction or normative spline rule.

sources.name: ACadSharp open annotative MLEADER writer report
sources.observed: The report says a no-op AC1032 round trip reopened by ACadSharp was rejected by AutoCAD LT audit and lost standalone annotation context objects. It reinforces that same-reader reopen is not independent/native acceptance.

sources.name: ezdxf entity exporter, XREF loader, and audit docs
sources.observed: The exporter documents that a target-version override does not convert unsupported features and may ignore them. The XREF loader explicitly supports only a subset and ignores unsupported records; audit/recovery is structural diagnosis rather than full feature-preserving conversion proof.

sources.name: FreeCAD importDWG.py current source
sources.observed: The DWG route converts to an intermediate DXF and calls the DXF importer. Automatic converter selection can try LibreDWG, ODA, and QCAD; DWGConversion=1 selects the LibreDWG branch, and the converter executable is resolved from the configured parameter or PATH.

sources.name: FreeCAD issue #20195
sources.observed: A non-GUI DXF import failure was reported for a 1.0.0 build; the issue was closed after a fix PR. It is not evidence that every packaged build or all headless paths work.

sources.name: FreeCAD merged PR #20328
sources.observed: Merged as commit 0986dad on 2025-03-31. The change fixes non-GUI C++ DXF importer handling of the Layer View object and adds a regression test. Use only as a build-preflight criterion; no target FreeCAD binary was tested.

sources.name: FreeCAD headless and DXF documentation
sources.observed: Headless mode exposes App document objects but does not create GUI documents or view providers; consequently it can qualify document/object data but not GUI rendering or view-provider behavior.

sources.name: LibreCAD_3 DWG support policy
sources.observed: LibreCAD_3 keeps DWG import opt-in/read-only and makes writer exposure conditional on promoted write claims, external reopen evidence, and a project decision. It is a downstream policy reference and shares libdxfrw lineage, so it is not an independent codec vote.

plan_effect.peer_comparison: Keep LibreDWG, ACadSharp, and ezdxf comparisons pinned to exact operation/version and capture loss/diagnostic evidence; do not treat project matrices, audits, or self-reopens as semantic acceptance.
plan_effect.freecad_fast_route: Use a pinned FreeCADCmd build containing or verifying the 0986dad non-GUI C++ importer fix, set DWGConversion=1, and configure the exact local dwg2dxf executable. Hash and inspect the intermediate DXF before importer results. If the exact headless path is unavailable, mark it NOT_RUN and use the existing GUI checkpoint.
plan_effect.freecad_evidence_scope: Headless checks cover App document objects and measurable geometry only. One GUI user-facing Open smoke per required platform remains necessary if that UI path is claimed. Stock FreeCAD DXF import does not qualify embedded ACIS/SAT semantic support.
plan_effect.validation_cadence: Keep generated fast selectors per implementation slice; batch optional/native FreeCAD checks at the existing composed checkpoint. No full suite or peer install was added per slice.
plan_effect.implementation_change: Plan-only readiness refinement. No implementation defect, new top-level finding/subplan, dependency, fixture, or support promotion was added.

repository_state: Only DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md and this research receipt were edited by this pass in a broadly dirty shared worktree; nothing was staged or committed.
